data_objects.name: baseball_player_records
data_objects.meaning: Baseball player salary, batting performance, fielding error, and labor-status eligibility records.
data_objects.notes: No player identifier or explicit performance-season field is present.

variables.name: salary_in_thousands_of_dollars
variables.meaning: Player salary expressed in thousands of dollars.

variables.name: batting_average
variables.meaning: Batting average, represented as a unitless proportion.

variables.meaning: On-base percentage, represented as a unitless proportion.

variables.meaning: Number of runs scored in the represented performance period.

variables.meaning: Number of hits in the represented performance period.

variables.name: number_of_walks

variables.name: indicator_of_arbitration_in_1991_1992
variables.meaning: Binary indicator that the player was in salary arbitration in the 1991-1992 period.

structure.description: Each row represents one player record, but no source player key is available in the table.
Batting average and on-base percentage are rate fields, named number_of_* fields are event counts, and labor-status fields are binary 0/1 indicators.
Empty CSV cells encode unavailable values in some performance and eligibility fields.

uncertainties: The player population, league, team, and performance period for the batting and fielding statistics are not stated.
The salary reference period and whether dollar amounts are nominal or adjusted are not provided.
The reason for unavailable performance or eligibility values is not encoded.
annotation_notes: The semantic map is grounded only in the declared train.csv header and values.
